dish_name_kh: សម្លកកូរផ្លែត្នោត
dish_name_en: Samlor Kako with Young Palm Fruit

ingredients.raw_kh: ត្រីអណ្តែងទន់
ផ្លែត្នោតខ្ចី
សំបកក្រូចសើច
ខ្ទឹមស-ក្រហម

steps.text_kh: មាន់ឬត្រីលាងទឹកឱ្យស្អាត កាប់ដុំៗទុកសិន
steps.text_en: Wash the chicken or fish clean and cut into pieces; set aside.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Kako with Young Palm Fruit, step 1: Wash the chicken or fish clean and cut into pieces; set aside.

steps.text_kh: ហាន់ស្លឹកគ្រៃឱ្យល្អិត យកទៅបុកជាមួយខ្ជាយរមៀតរំដេង សំបកក្រូចសើច ខ្ទឹមស-ក្រហមឱ្យម៉ដ្ឋទុកសិន អង្ករលីងកិនឱ្យល្អិត
steps.text_en: Finely chop lemongrass and pound with fingerroot, turmeric, galangal, kaffir lime zest, and garlic-shallot until smooth; set aside. Grind roasted rice powder finely.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Kako with Young Palm Fruit, step 2: Finely chop lemongrass and pound with fingerroot, turmeric, galangal, kaffir lime zest, and garlic-shallot until smooth; set aside. Grind roasted rice powder finely.

steps.text_kh: យកឆ្នាំងដាក់ទឹកកន្លះ យកត្នោតខ្ចីមកចិតឱ្យស្តើងដាក់ក្នុងឆ្នាំង ដាំចំនួនពីរអំពុះ
steps.text_en: Put half a pot of water on the heat, peel and thinly slice the young palm fruit into the pot, and bring to a boil twice.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Kako with Young Palm Fruit, step 3: Put half a pot of water on the heat, peel and thinly slice the young palm fruit into the pot, and bring to a boil twice.

steps.text_kh: ជ្រុំប្រហុក បង់សាច់ត្រីឬមាន់ រួចដាក់គ្រឿងដែលបុកចូលនិងអង្ករលីង
steps.text_en: Add a block of prahok and the fish or chicken meat, then add the pounded spice paste and roasted rice powder.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Kako with Young Palm Fruit, step 4: Add a block of prahok and the fish or chicken meat, then add the pounded spice paste and roasted rice powder.

steps.text_kh: ចាក់ទឹកត្រីអំបិល ស្ករ ម្សៅស៊ុប ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មមតាមចូលចិត្ត
steps.text_en: Season with fish sauce, salt, sugar, and soup powder; taste and adjust to preference.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Samlor Kako with Young Palm Fruit, step 5: Season with fish sauce, salt, sugar, and soup powder; taste and adjust to preference.
